text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Fan Appreciation Festival, 
Mejiro Dober had been lost in thought. She 
managed to pull herself together and head 
into the race, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by Mejiro Bright's incredible 
focus and aura in the paddock, they could 
feel Mejiro Bright's absolute resolve for 
the Tenno Sho (Spring).
